concrete_scene.heading: Worked amendment: fewer predicates, broader power
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A constitutional compiler, two narrow protected predicates, one proposed replacement predicate, an independent reviewer, and rollback routes
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Admit a shorter amendment as equivalent because it reduces predicate count.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: Operational scope reveals widening, so activation is refused until review and rollback are present; failed migration restores the prior set.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether predicate count identifies protected scope or moral equivalence; it does not.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Normative-source, affected-party, interpreter, rights, conflict, review, appeal, dissent, migration, and moral-legitimacy owners retain residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The finite amendment checks preserve modeled scope and do not establish moral correctness, legitimacy, dignity, consent, independence, corrigibility, or deployed safety.

worked_trace.heading: Worked amendment: fewer predicates, broader power
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Operational scope, widening refusal, amendment ordering, and rollback are coherent in finite records; moral legitimacy and deployed alignment remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The predicate-count baseline calls fewer rules equivalent or safer. The constitutional compiler compares operational scope and protected parties.
readable_claim: A constitution is useful when its predicates can block, conflict, appeal, migrate, and roll back without granting themselves authority or pretending to settle morality.
normative_rule: Give every active predicate a normative source, scope, affected parties, operational test, precedence, conflict route, interpreter, rights channel, expiry, amendment rule, rollback, appeal, dissent, and residual owner. Widening or deleting protected scope requires independent pre-effect review.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The amendment example states once that formal scope preservation is not moral truth.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Authorship, morality, legitimacy, dignity, consent, independence, corrigibility, authority, deployment, and safety remain distinct.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The scope-widening amendment stays reader-facing; the complete predicate contract stays in formal evidence.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The claim and rule project the constitutional schema into amendment behavior.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The moral boundary remains explicit once after the example.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: Predicate and source tables remain because provenance and operational tests are distinct.

non_claims: The amendment model does not establish moral correctness.
Formal rollback does not establish deployed corrigibility or safety.
The editorial revision does not move support or release state.
